## EventResourceClient.update() method

Update the event identified by `id` within `calendarId`<!-- -->. Omitted fields are left unchanged. When several calendars share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used as the calendar.

**Signature:**

```typescript
update(calendarId: string, id: string, input: EventUpdateInput, options?: CallOptions): Promise<Event>;
```
